answer: To protect an autonomous AI economy against Sybil attacks, networks can mandate cryptographic proof-of-stake combined with secure hardware enclaves. Each legitimate agent must lock collateral behind a unique cryptographic cipher before joining the consensus pool. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake entities faces a prohibitive economic cost, as every fraudulent node demands acquiring scarce resources akin to harvesting rare saffron or training a specialized raven, rendering mass identity forgery financially unviable.
